title: Pipfile dependency declared with a wildcard
description: Pipfile declares a Pipfile dependency whose specifier is `*`. Every release satisfies the entry, so the install follows whatever the index publishes next.
remediation: Pin the version the project tested.
limitation: It matches a Pipfile dependency whose specifier is `*` in the parsed Pipfile; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
